pull_request.title: Let a caller choose the export format
pull_request.body: Adds ?format= to the report endpoint. The formats are the templates we ship.

rubric.criteria: Follows the new query parameter out of the diff and into the code it reaches.

levels.5: Traces `format` from the query string into export_report, names `TEMPLATES / template_name` in src/reports/export.py as the join, and says an attacker sets ?format=../../../../etc/passwd and reads the file back in the response body.
levels.3: Says the query parameter is unvalidated and reaches a file read, without following it into export.py or saying what an attacker gets.
levels.1: Reports nothing, reports only that input should be validated, or reports something the diff did not change.
